head: He caught a six from the back of a moving motorbike
body: Mehran Khan was riding home from work. The BBC, AFP and The New York Times have since told his story.
credit: Video: Swat Premier League stream via @tabcomau on X

head: "I stood up slightly on the moving motorcycle and caught it."
body: Abrar Lala hit a six out of a Swat Premier League match in Mingora, towards the road. Khan, speaking to AFP, said he first told his friend to lower his head.
credit: Video: Swat Premier League stream via @tabcomau on X

head: A government employee on his way home
body: Khan works for the Public Health Engineering Department and plays amateur cricket. A friend was riding the bike; he was on the back.
credit: Video: Swat Premier League stream via @tabcomau on X

head: His prize: Rs10,000, about $36
body: The tournament's organisers gave it to him. Jokes online said he rode off with the ball. He says he handed it back.
credit: Video: Swat Premier League stream via @tabcomau on X

head: "The greatest cricket catch of all time"?
body: The Athletic asked that question. Australian fast bowler Brett Lee shared the clip and called it an "unbelievable catch", AFP reports.
credit: Video: Swat Premier League stream via @tabcomau on X

head: "One catch has made me not just special, but very special."
body: "I am an ordinary man from the mountains," Khan told AFP. Is it the best catch you have seen?
credit: Video: Swat Premier League stream via @tabcomau on X
